name: tree to sequence by leaf removal
mechanism: repeatedly remove the smallest-labelled leaf and record its neighbour, producing a sequence two shorter than the vertex count that determines the tree uniquely and can be decoded back

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Prüfer coding' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms: conversion between a labeled tree and its Prüfer sequence

requires: labelled vertices with a total order on labels
fails_when: unlabelled trees have no canonical code this way
